quest.title: Outrider Style
quest.description: During your pursuit, you track Raptor to his hideout. You plunge into its depths without hesitation. Time to bring this criminal to justice.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x275, Primogem x60, Mora x6175, Teachings of Freedom x5, Adventurer's Experience x3, Fine Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: There's only one way over there. Raptor must be up ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It looks like there's no way across... Ugh, he must be around here somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Amber, over there!

dialogues.speaker: Raptor
dialogues.text: If you insist on chasing me, so be it... Huh? Who brought the little girl?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: You must be Raptor! You can't escape!

dialogues.speaker: Raptor
dialogues.text: Haha, I don't need to escape! There's no way you can make it over here.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Oh... It is pretty high... and quite far...

dialogues.speaker: Raptor
dialogues.text: Oh, little girl, why don't you run along home now and let your leader deal with this? Don't worry, I promise that once the Grand Master gets here, I'll surrender immediately! Haha!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hey, watch it! You're talking to a Knights of Favonius Outrider! You'll be sorry when I arrest you!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: ...You're right.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Ugh... He's right there in front of us... If only we could glide across.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So how did HE get across?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I don't see a mechanism, and I have good eyesight.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Besides, there's nowhere on the ledge that you could build one.

response.speaker: Raptor
response.text: Bye-bye, kiddo...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no! He's getting away!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: We can't hesitate any longer. The only way to get across is to glide there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... but...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Don't worry — I'm the Gliding Champion of Mondstadt, remember! If Raptor can do it, I can do it too.

response.speaker: Raptor
response.text: Oi, Outrider! You have less chance of surviving this than jumping off the Anemo God statue in Mondstadt without your wind glider! Haha!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon sees your point {NICKNAME}... If you rule out everything that's completely impossible, gliding is the only idea left.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, remember that book I lent you? The one I thought was the gliding manual, but wasn't?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: The first birds couldn't fly. Flight was their reward for their courage to plunge into the canyon.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Be my witness.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Go! Go! Outrider!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Roger! Let's show this guy what an Outrider is made of!

response.speaker: Raptor
response.text: Wait... Stop! You'll never make it! Come on, off you go now, back home like a good little girl.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Raptor says I'll never make it. But, if you listen carefully...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: The wind! The wind says I WILL make it, and that's good enough for me!

choices.text: This will take some serious guts, but it's not completely impossible.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, can you see anything with your Elemental Sight...? No? Oh, okay... Never mind...

choices.text: A grappling hook, or spikes, or something?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If it's too far to glide, it's definitely too far for anything like that.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: There's also no sign of an anchor point.

choices.text: Let's examine our surroundings — just like you taught me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Amber, no! You're gonna fall! You're gonna fall—!

talks.objective: Track down Raptor and arrest him!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Alright! I got him!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I only noticed the wind current from in the air — and it's the only one.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It would be suicide to try and escape in the direction Raptor was going.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: In other words, the only way Raptor could have gotten out would be this way — past us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha! So he was just trying to fool us by acting smug, in the hope that we would just give up and leave.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Little did he know, we're not so easily fooled.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: #It was all thanks to {NICKNAME}'s sharp thinking! Just like a wise man once said, "Once you eliminate the impossible, whatever remains, no matter how improbable, must be the truth."

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: At the end of the day, gliding is seven parts technique, three parts instinct — and then 90 parts courage.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What you did now looked more like 99 parts courage...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Ah, it was just like in my first gliding exam... I was super nervous, but in the end, there was nothing to be afraid of and I passed no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I kinda missed that nervous rush in the exams I've done since then... It just wasn't the same.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Erm, sorry — Paimon thought you said you passed no problem? What do you mean, exams since then?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Ah... Well you see, the thing is, Mondstadt is all "no glide zone" this, "no landing zone" that...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: *sigh* Every time I get my license it keeps getting revoked. I must have taken the exam about 15 times altogether...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: But I always pass the first time. I guess my little gliding manual ain't so bad after all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #...{NICKNAME}, let's go and get a copy of the real gliding manual from Acting Grand Master Jean some time.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I'll head off first because I need to escort Raptor back to the city.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Once you're back in the city don't forget to come find me at the Cathedral. I'll issue your gliding license there.

talks.objective: Go to the Cathedral to get your gliding license

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Congratulations, here is your gliding license! You're officially legal now, yay!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I'm not surprised though, you are a natural after all.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh — and I'll sign you up for the next Wind Gliding Championship!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I glide so fast that no one can keep up — it's just me up there, on my own, gliding around... It's kinda boring.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Ooh... Fighting talk! Heh. It seems you have no idea how terrifying the championship really is...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Well, until I kick your butt in the championship, I wish you a happy, liberating, and above all law-abiding gliding experience.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Make sure you obey the rules. Whatever you do, don't get your license revoked...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh brother... If you ask me, that's a bit rich, coming from Amber...

choices.text: You won't stand a chance of winning if you sign me up.
I actually put a lot of effort into this.
